design_notes: The report must adopt a professional, intelligence-grade aesthetic suitable for senior law enforcement and security personnel. It should utilize a clean, readable layout with a dark text-on-light background (white and very light gray) for optimal legibility. The visual design incorporates a vibrant yet controlled palette of navy, blue, cyan, teal, green, amber, orange, red, pink, and violet accents to convey information clearly through color-coded elements such as sentiment indicators, platform-specific branding, and data visualization components like charts, heatmaps, and progress bars. All UI elements—cards, badges, tables, timeline markers—are styled with rounded corners, subtle shadows, and consistent spacing for clarity and modernity. Responsive CSS ensures usability across devices, while A4 print-friendly styling maintains readability when printed. No placeholders or fictional content are allowed; all data must be derived directly from verified MATRIX database sources.
